headline: IHSG Under Pressure, Check Out 5 Stock Picks for Today
summary: The IHSG fell 1.02% to 5,194.14, with the basic industry sector down 2.31%. Foreign investors recorded net sales of Rp662 billion.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks the main stocks listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, so its moves reflect broad sentiment in Indonesian equities.
why_moved: The index fell as the basic industry sector dropped 2.31% and foreign investors recorded net sales of Rp662 billion.
original_headline: IHSG Tertekan, Simak 5 Saham Pilihan Hari Ini
